meta.name: Black Tea
meta.tagline: Your agent can pay. You decide how much.
meta.category: Spending controls for AI agents that pay online
meta.organising_principle: Every surface is built around a receipt: mono keys and values joined by dotted leaders, on near-black, with amber only where a human decides.
meta.reference_points: Looks like: a till receipt, a terminal at night, Linear's restraint, Resend's dark, Oxide's engineering candour. Does not look like: purple AI gradients, crypto dashboards, Charm's neon, a plain-HTML docs page, a stark white Vercel grid, mascots, stock photos, serif headlines.
meta.weird_detail: Dotted leaders between every key and its value, like a paper receipt, on every surface including marketing.

semantic._note: Black Tea is dark only: 'light' and 'dark' hold the same near-black values on purpose, so theme.css renders the brand whatever the reader's system setting. 'print' is a paper variant for PDFs and embeds that must be light; it is not exported to theme.css.

_rules: Black Tea is dark only. theme.css is near-black in every colour scheme. A paper variant for print lives in color.semantic.print; use it only for PDFs and embeds that must be light.
Amber marks a human decision: the held state, the Approve button, the tea in the mark. At most two amber elements per viewport, plus the glow.
One hue. Green and red are states on a receipt, never decoration, never a button fill.
No gradients on surfaces. Exception: one radial amber glow (accent.subtle) behind one receipt per page.
Never pure black, never pure white.

webfonts._use: The one stylesheet that loads both faces. Self-host for production.

display._use: Same face as text. Headlines at 600, tight.

mono._use: Money, wallet addresses, ids, hashes, receipts, code, uppercase labels. Never a sentence longer than a line.

scale._note: Display breaks the ratio on purpose: 72px over 16px body, 4.5:1.

display._sample: Your agent can pay. You decide how much.

h3._sample: The price changes after you said yes.

lead._use: The paragraph under the hero, in ink.muted with one phrase in ink.base.
lead._sample: Black Tea sits between an AI agent and its wallet.

body._sample: An approval is bound to the exact request.

label._use: Overlines and receipt headers. Never a sentence.

caption._sample: reported by the agent, not proof

metric._use: Every value on a receipt: amounts, addresses, hashes, states.

platform.email_pdf: System sans and system mono. Never a webfont in mail.
platform._rule: Anything a person could copy and paste into a terminal or a wallet is set in mono.
platform._why: One neutral face keeps the type out of the way; the receipt and the amber carry the brand.

_rules: Two faces, three weights of Geist (400, 500, 600), two of Geist Mono (400, 500). No serif, ever. No italics.
Display leading 1.0, tracking -0.035em. Never looser.
Money is always mono with two decimals and the currency after: 12.00 USDC.
Uppercase only in mono labels, tracked 0.08em.
Sentence case everywhere else. The wordmark is lowercase: black tea.

space._note: Absolute numeric scale. Never an intermediate value.
_rules: Every value comes from the scale.
Section padding is space.9 top, space.10 bottom on desktop; space.8 under 900px.
A receipt row is space.1 tall padding; rows are dense on purpose.
Three values in use: 2, 6, 12px.
Pill is for the mark's circle and avatars only. Never a pill button.
Nested radii decrease inward.

shadow._philosophy: None. Black Tea separates surfaces with a 1px hairline and one step of lightness.
shadow.dark_note: Shadows are invisible on near-black. Use border.hairline and surface.raised.

_rules: Opacity and up to 8px of travel. Nothing scales, nothing bounces.
A receipt's state may change in place: the value cross-fades in 150ms. The row does not move.
No scroll-triggered animation, no parallax, no animated background.
Honour prefers-reduced-motion: no motion at all.

principles.name: State changes, nothing else moves
principles.rule: Motion exists to show a payment going from held to approved, denied or expired.

principles.name: Fast
principles.rule: 150ms by default. A developer should never wait for the page.

principles.name: Still by default
principles.rule: A page at rest has nothing moving on it.

motion.temperament: Precise and quick. Motion confirms a decision; it never performs.

_rules: Left-aligned to a 12-column grid. Hero is 7/5: words left, one receipt right.
Sections are 4/8: title left, content right, a hairline above.
Nothing is centred. Exception: the 404 and an empty playground state.

formats.name: Web hero
formats.rule: Headline on the left seven columns, one receipt on the right five, glow behind the receipt.

formats.name: Social card (og.png)
formats.rule: Mark and wordmark top left, the headline, one three-row receipt bottom right. Near-black ground.

formats.name: README header
formats.rule: Mark, wordmark, one line. No receipt.

iconify._use: The set any build renders from.

_rules: Icons are rare: prefer a mono label to an icon.
1.5px stroke, ink.muted. Never amber, except the hand on a held state.
Never an icon above a feature heading in a three-column grid.

logo.construction: The mark is a cup of black tea seen from above: a 2px ring, an amber disc, a handle on the right. The wordmark is 'black tea' in Geist 600, lowercase, -0.03em, to the right of the mark at a gap of 0.36 of the mark's height.
logo.clearspace: Half the height of the mark on all sides
permitted_colors: leaf.100 ring with amber.500 disc on tea.950
tea.950 ring with amber.700 disc on light
one colour: leaf.100 or tea.950, disc as a filled circle
_rules: The disc is the only amber in the lockup.
Never put the mark in a container, never add a steam line, a leaf or a saucer.
Never set the wordmark in capitals or title case.
At 16px the mark stands alone, without the wordmark.

art_direction.concept: The moment before the money moves.
art_direction._concept_use: Brief every page, image and demo against this line: show the instant a payment is held and a human can still say no.

principles.name: Show the receipt, not the promise
principles.rule: Every claim sits next to real output: a receipt, a policy file, a terminal line. A page with only adjectives is not finished.

principles.name: Amber means a human decides
principles.rule: Colour marks the decision and nothing else. If nothing on screen is held or approvable, nothing is amber except the mark.

principles.name: Nothing behind a wall
principles.rule: Everything can be tried without an email address: install command, playground, source. No sign-up, no waitlist.

formula.subject: One receipt for one payment, with a real-looking amount, payee, rule and reason.
formula.light: Near-black, with one faint amber glow behind the receipt, as if lit by a cup of tea.
formula.colour: Ink on near-black. Amber once or twice. Green and red only as a state value.
formula.framing: Words left, receipt right, both starting at the same top edge. Left-aligned.
formula.type_on_image: There are no images. Type sits on the page; values sit in a receipt.

hierarchy.job: Carries the brand and proves the product on every surface.
Says the one thing the page is for.
Shows how, when the reader asks.
Almost nothing. A mono label is preferred.

art_direction.weird_detail: Dotted leaders between every key and its value, like a paper receipt, on every surface including marketing.
_rules: One receipt per viewport, at most.
Every key-value pair anywhere on a page uses dotted leaders, not a table and not a colon.
Examples are topical and true: a real kind of purchase, a plausible amount. Never 'foo', never 'Acme'.
No photographs, no illustrations, no mascots, no 3D.

attributes.means: Numbers, units and names. '12.00 USDC to 0x8f3c…a21b', not 'a payment'.
No exclamation marks, no urgency. Short declarative sentences.
One understated line is allowed per page. 'reported by the agent, not proof.'
Say what it does, then show it. The reader decides if it matters.

voice.person: You and your agent. 'We' only for the project's own decisions.
voice.sentence_length: Average under 16 words. Two-sentence headlines are welcome.
voice.locale: en-US spelling in product and docs. 24-hour clock. Amount then currency: 12.00 USDC.
voice.capitalisation: Sentence case for everything. 'Black Tea' in prose, 'black tea' in the wordmark only.
voice.punctuation: No exclamation marks. No em dashes. Full stops in headlines that are sentences.
voice.core: en-US · Sentence case · No exclamation marks · Money in mono

messaging.one_liner: Black Tea puts spending limits and human approval between an AI agent and its wallet.
messaging.elevator: An agent with a wallet will pay whatever it is asked to, by you or by a web page. Black Tea checks every payment against a policy file, holds the ones that need a human, and leaves a receipt bound to the exact request that was approved. Open source: SDK, CLI and MCP server.
messaging.positioning: For developers who give an AI agent a way to pay and want a limit that is not the wallet's balance. Unlike a number written in a prompt, the policy is enforced outside the model and every approval leaves a receipt.

pillars.name: A policy the model cannot talk its way around
pillars.proof: Rules are evaluated in code, outside the prompt, before anything is signed.

pillars.name: A human for what falls outside
pillars.proof: Payments above your rules are held with an expiry; approve or reject from your own channel.

pillars.name: A receipt for every approval
pillars.proof: Each approval is bound to a hash of the exact request and can be used once.

proof_points: An approval cannot be replayed, altered or used after it expires.
A quote that changes amount, payee, network or token after approval is refused before signing.
Per-wallet and per-host limits count what was already paid.
messaging.boilerplate: Black Tea is an open-source TypeScript library, CLI and MCP server that puts spending controls on AI agents paying online. It supports x402 (USDC on Base) today.

photography.point_of_view: None. Black Tea does not use photography.
never: Robots, glowing brains, abstract AI renders
photography._rule: No photography. Use a receipt, a policy file or a terminal line.

illustration.source: Not applicable. Black Tea does not illustrate.
illustration.never: Mascots, characters, spot illustrations, 3D objects, isometric diagrams.
illustration.next_one: If a page feels empty, show another real receipt state or remove the section.
illustration._rule: Black Tea does not illustrate. The mark is the only drawn thing.

imagery.charts: Rare. Mono axis labels in ink.muted, hairline gridlines, one ink series. Amber only for the point where a limit was hit.

provenance._legend: stated = the founder said it · inferred = derived from what they chose · assumed = filled in; go and check
breaks_if: The people who adopt it are finance or ops teams, not developers: the dark terminal register would then be the wrong room.
Black Tea becomes a hosted product with accounts: 'nothing behind a wall' no longer holds as written.
A second rail (SEPA, cards) becomes the main story: the crypto-flavoured examples would mislead.
provenance.expires: Revisit after the first public launch has produced real feedback, or at the first outside contributor who touches the site.
validate: Show the landing page to three developers who build agents and ask them to say back what it does after ten seconds.
Put a competitor's name on the hero and check whether the receipt still looks like theirs.
Read the first fifty launch comments and list every word people use for the problem; compare with voice.vocabulary.
